Name: Emily Revamped - Sprite and Portrait
Author: EvidentlyThinking
Description:
I never really liked the vanilla emily portrait and sprite, so I decided to give them a bit of a revamp!

Includes:
Character Portrait
Character Sprite

Installation:
Content Patcher:
Download the (CP) Version
Unzip the file
Add the file inside to your Stardew Valley Mods folder 

Manually (replacing the xnb files)
This replaces the original .xnb sprite and portrait files, so make a backup of your originals so you can always go back!
Download the xnb files, Unzip the folder
Place the file in character (Emily.xnb) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Characters and let it overwrite
Place the file in Portraits (Emily.xnb) into the Stardew Valley folder under Content\Portraits and let it overwrite

Enjoy! If there are ever any issues let me know.
